stem.en: Three students make sugar solutions. A dissolves 20 g of sugar in 80 g of water. B dissolves 20 g in 100 g of water. C dissolves 30 g in 80 g of water. Which line gives the right % m/m values, and the most concentrated solution?

text.en: A 25 %, B 20 %, C 37.5 %: C is the most concentrated.
A 20 %, B 20 %, C 30 %: C is the most concentrated.
A 20 %, B 16.7 %, C 27.3 %: C is the most concentrated.
A 20 %, B 16.7 %, C 27.3 %: B is the most concentrated.

explanation.en: Add solute and solvent first. A: 20 / 100 = 20 %. B: 20 / 120 = 16.7 %. C: 30 / 110 = 27.3 %. So C is the most concentrated, because its percentage is the highest. Option a divides by the water alone. Option b uses the grams of sugar as the percentage. Option d has the right numbers but picks the solution with the most liquid.

hints.en: Find the mass of each solution first.
The most concentrated solution has the highest percentage.
